template.name: Burial (UK garage shuffle)
template.about: 2-step shuffle at 136, vinyl crackle, pitched vocal shards, sub, reverb fog.

project.name: Burial (UK garage shuffle)
project.notes:
BURIAL  (Burial, Untrue; 2006-2007)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- Made Untrue in Sound Forge (The Wire, unedited transcript, Mark Fisher 2007); on sequencers:
  "it's blocks in different colours and I'm only used to just seeing the waves".
- "Pitching down female vocals so they sound male, and pitching up male vocals"; cut-up
  a cappellas; "I partly use the rain to cover up..." (The Wire).
- Four Tet: "he's never used a quantiser" (MusicRadar/Future Music, 2010).

THIS TEMPLATE
Shuffle Drums rack at 62% (UK garage 2-step; The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.) into CHOWTapeModel "Lofi Vibe" on the
Drum Bus; Vocal Shards Sampler (quantize off) with Pro Wave Tune shifting pitch -5 and formant
+3 semitones (correction off; it follows one voice at a time); sub bass; fog pad; Surge XT
"Vinyl" crackle track.

WORKFLOW
Place hits by ear rather than on the grid (turn the pattern into a plain region and drag
notes). Pitch vocals across gender as Burial describes.

MIX NOTES
- Reverb is the room: ValhallaSupermassive 100% wet on the Reverb return, high cut low.
- Drum Bus: slow built-in compression. Music Bus: CHOWTapeModel "Underwater".
- Master quiet: CHOWTapeModel "Cassette Like", Lemon Limiter; -14 to -11 LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good. No rain/field recordings are included: record or bring your own. The drums are
synthesized one-shots.

SOURCES
The Wire "Burial: Unedited Transcript" (Mark Fisher, Dec 2007); MusicRadar/Future Music "Four
Tet in the studio" (2010); Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- CHOWTapeModel (GPL-3.0): https://chowdsp.com/products.html
- ValhallaSupermassive (freeware): https://valhalladsp.com/valhallasupermassive/

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 136 BPM, 4/4, key Ebmin, cycle bars 1-8.

Tracks
- Shuffle Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (909) = kick-909.wav, Snare / Clap (909) = clap.wav, Rim (909) = rim.wav, Hat = hat-acoustic.wav, Shaker (CR-78) = shaker.wav)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (12 steps on), swing 62% (MPC terms), 5 rows = the rack's channels
- Vocal Shards (pitched) (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Sampler (SP-303 model): effect Pitch on, CTRL 1-3 = 55%, 20%, 70%; quantize oFF; pad grade standard
    FX: Pro Wave Tune: pitch shift -5 st, formant +3 st, correction off
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -6 dB
- Sub Bass (Instrument, -6 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Sub 1"
- Pad / Fog (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Pads/Fading Memory"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -6 dB
- Crackle / Rain (Instrument, -18 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "FX/Vinyl"

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Lofi Vibe"; Compressor (Threshold -16, Ratio 2, Attack 20, Release 300, Make-up 2)
- Music Bus (bus 2): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Underwater"
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): empty
- Reverb (bus 4): Valhalla DSP, LLC: ValhallaSupermassive: default settings; Mix 1.0, Feedback 0.7, Delay_Ms 0.5, Density 0.8, HighCut 0.6
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 661.8, Feedback 0.5, Tone 3000, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Channel EQ (High -2); Compressor (Threshold -14, Ratio 2, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Cassette Like"; Lemon Limiter: gain +2 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
